problem_statement: When parsing CoAP options, a sequence whose cumulative option number overflows the 16-bit option-number field is silently accepted instead of being rejected. For example, a first option with delta 65535 (option number reaching the maximum 65535) followed by a second option with a non-zero delta wraps the running option number back to a small value, producing a non-monotonic option sequence that violates RFC 7252. Iterating such options must stop with a parse error rather than continuing. Repeated options with a zero delta at the maximum option number must still be accepted.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
